snippet.title: Zoo Tycoon: Marine Mania - Orca Show (Scenario 1)
snippet.description:
Thought about putting narration to this one, but ultimately decided not to. 
Scenario is one of what I like to call "the good kind" because I don't have to wait around at the end, although it did take me a little longer as I am not as well versed in Marine Mania as I am with the base game - a story I am sure will be told in another video down the road.
